source.title: Howling Wind Ambience
source.author: DBlover
source.notes: 48 kHz stereo MP3, 85 s: a rumbling howl, nearly all under 200 Hz, with gusts thudding on the microphone (under 65 Hz) at 0.7-7.9, 14, 21-22, 49, 56, 63 and 69 s. The old loop was 13.6 s of it from 53.2 s (r 1.00), stereo at 44.1 kHz. Cut again 2026-11-10: 40 s from 25 s, kept stereo, the rumble turned down and the thuds high-passed away. Bass -4 dB under 150 Hz (chosen over -8); the level matches the old loop's loudness (-30.5 LUFS), as its average level was mostly sub-bass.
